summary: Iter55 tested the Birthday Card Wall, Nudge All Expired, handover photo captions and the single-nudge regression. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed. Covered: wall open window (±7 days, 8 days = closed), birthday in_days/turns/date, one message per user (posting again updates it), mine/can_remove flags, empty or >300-char text gives 400, exactly 300 accepted, unassigned worker gets 403, assigned worker can sign, worker can't remove an admin's message (403), admin removes a worker's message, 404s. Nudge-all: employee gets 403; returns {nudged:2, workers:1}; only expired certs are nudged (the expiring one is not); one notification per cert; a second call returns 0/0. Single nudge still works (200, then 400 the same day, 404, 403). Caption PATCH: uploader and manager can edit, input is trimmed and cut to 200 chars, a non-uploader worker gets 403, unknown photo gives 404. Frontend at 390x844, all passed: birthday wall sign, post, edit (pre-filled) and remove; team-certificates 'Nudge all expired (1 worker)' opens the confirm sheet, sends, and the button disappears with 'Reminder sent today by Alex Admin' on both expired certs; per-cert 'Nudge to renew' still works. The handover caption UI can't be reached with real data (no Jotform handovers exist), so I injected a handover into the /api/caseload response with page.route and seeded one photo. The viewer's Edit caption saves through PATCH and the change is in the DB. The library picker opens handover-caption-sheet and handover-caption-input, and the upload correctly fails with 400 because the handover is fake. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: send_nudge runs once per certificate, so a worker with N expired certs gets N app notifications and N emails from one tap. Consider one notification and one email per worker listing all their certs.

'Already nudged today' is based on the UTC date (now_iso()[:10]), not Perth time. A nudge sent at 7am Perth (23:00 UTC the previous day) can be sent again at 9am Perth. The frontend also uses the UTC date for the 'Reminder sent today' label.

issues: Remove (trash) deletes the message straight away, with no confirmation and no success toast (ConfirmSheet is available in participant-sheets).
After the birthday, the wording says 'X turns 36 3 days ago'; it should be 'turned'. Reference: src/components/birthday-wall.tsx:52
The Cancel button in edit mode has no testID.

The caption edit TextInput is inside a full-screen Modal with no KeyboardAvoidingView. On iOS the keyboard will cover the input and the Save button. Reference: src/components/handover-photos.tsx:146-175
Remove in the viewer deletes the photo straight away, with no confirmation.

action_items: (Optional) Group nudge-all notifications and emails per worker instead of per certificate.
(Optional) Use the Perth date (DIGEST_TZ) for the once-a-day nudge check on both backend and frontend.
Wrap the handover photo viewer caption editor in a KeyboardAvoidingView.
Add a confirmation step before removing a birthday message or handover photo; change 'turns' to 'turned' when birthday.in_days < 0.
critical_code_review_comments: edit_handover_caption doesn't call can_see_participant. The uploader/can_manage check makes this safe, but the access check is inconsistent with GET and DELETE (which also don't check). Fine as is.
can_manage excludes HR, so HR can view and sign the birthday wall but can't remove other people's messages or edit captions. Confirm this is intended.
The participant header's 'participant-birthday' line shows the NEXT birthday, while the wall can show the birthday just passed (up to 7 days after). The two can show different ages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (birthday wall, nudge all, per-cert nudge, caption edit and caption sheet via injected handover)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only, and all cleaned up: TEST55/TESTUI certs (deleted), user_testemp001 hidden:false and then restored to true, the employee temporarily assigned to Test Birthday Person and then removed, DOB changed and restored to 1990-11-03, birthday_messages deleted (0 left; this includes the main agent's earlier 'Happy birthday!! 🎉' admin message, which my upsert overwrote), seeded handover_photos deleted, test notifications deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No real Jotform handovers exist. To test the handover photo UI, use page.route on the URL ending /api/caseload to inject participants[0].handover, and seed a matching db.handover_photos doc. The nudge-all confirm Sheet slides in: wait about 1.5s before clicking team-certs-nudge-all-confirm. No real non-hidden user has expired certs, so nudge-all only reaches seeded test certs.
